changeSet.author: doge-removal
changeSet.comment: DOGE support removed (MVP): there is no good free RPC provider for Dogecoin and it was the last consumer of Tatum. Purge every row whose network is DOGE before the enum constant is dropped from BlockchainNetwork — otherwise Hibernate fails mapping the orphaned 'DOGE' string on read. No user holds DOGE, so this strands no funds. Child rows that reference a DOGE wallet are deleted before the wallet rows themselves.
